facts.raw_span: 1-year history of progressive left hip pain radiating to the anterior thigh
pain began as a dull aching groin discomfort, worsened over weeks, was severe at night
associated with weight loss and anorexia
no history of trauma
antalgic gait
reduced range of motion of the left hip in all planes with spasms
tenderness deep in the left groin
straight-leg raising was negative
neurologic examination was normal
laboratory studies, including complete blood count, erythrocyte sedimentation rate, and C-reactive protein, were within normal limits
pelvic radiograph was unremarkable
MRI of the left hip showed synovitis and marrow edema without fracture
